'''Tero Reskan''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. At one [[Time/Legends|time]], he ran a [[Starship/Legends|shipping]] business that operated on routes through the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]], but the business was eventually nationalized by the Empire and Reskan was forced out of the organization. He became an agent of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and in about [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Reskan acted as a contact for a team of [[Alderaanian Resistance]] [[operative]]s that were [[Mission to Coruscant (Imperial era)|dispatched]] to Coruscant to locate the headquarters of a [[Sarlacc Project|clandestine Imperial project]]. The agents subsequently infiltrated [[Imeici Spire]], a [[Skyscraper/Legends|skyscraper]] in the [[CoCo Town/Legends|CoCo Town]] district in which the project was based, and afterward Reskan picked them up in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and took them to a safehouse. He then passed on to Organa information regarding the outcome of the mission.<ref name="The Core of Corruption" />
